summary: Fixed git-commit-scoped.sh's V2 gate to three-way classify pathspecs (matched / already-staged-deletion / genuinely-unmatched) with a decoupled git add set, closing the defect where a scoped commit silently dropped staged deletions and renames. Red-first T8/T9/T10 regression tests added and confirmed failing before the fix, all-PASS after; deployed .claude/ tree refreshed to byte-identical parity.
